user_saw: After a session was replaced, a client had no way to tell the gateway to reject Stop based on the session ID it had originally observed.
summary: The fix lets clients pass an optional sessionId to exact-run chat.abort and rejects the request if that ID differs from either the current session or the selected local or worker run.
reasoning: I checked the September Stop authorization change and the handler before the October session-controller refactor. The older code bound narrowly scoped callers to the admitted session ID and explicitly allowed broad Stop to target a run in another session. The fix adds an opt-in safeguard, and its documentation and tests confirm that requests omitting sessionId retain the earlier behavior.
